Message:
It’d been a few days since then,
but the Hero’s condition
still hadn’t improved.

I was overrun with worry,
but Elaine, calm as ever,
was in charge of treating him.
That must mean
he’ll get better soon, right?

At my question,
Elaine turned towards me,
a small smile playing on her lips.

“He’s not going to make it.
It’s only a matter of time
until the Hero is dead.”

Seeing me at a
complete loss for words,
Elaine began to
explain everything.

The Curse hadn’t been dispelled.
The Hero had sealed it all
within his own body,
and now he’s finally
reached his limit.

My voice trembled
with uncertainty,
but Elaine just
nodded assuredly.

“Of course.
I just need to excise
the Hero’s spirit,
and place it in another body.”
